meta.name: conquer
meta.description: Supervised-autonomous build: Cesar drives an external builder CLI (codex/claude/agy) unattended toward a task, convening nero/tribunal/council on forks, and stops at a human merge gate. `agon conquer "<task>" --gate "<test cmd>"`.

builder.description: Builder engine (codex|claude|agy). Default: codex if active, else the first active engine.

engines.description: Advisor pool for consults (comma-separated). Default: active orchestration engines minus the builder.

gate.description: REQUIRED — the acceptance gate command (build/typecheck/lint/tests), e.g. "npm run build && npm test". This IS the done-oracle.

push.description: On success, commit and push the isolated conquer branch (prints a PR hint). Default: leave the isolated branch/worktree for review.

label.description: Human-readable suffix baked into the run dir name.
